title: The bird that made Darwin sick
caption:
One feather nearly broke a theory.

Darwin's fix was a second force alongside natural selection: traits can spread simply because mates prefer them. He set it out in full in The Descent of Man (1871).

Source: Darwin Correspondence Project (letter 2743); Britannica.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
